caption: The video captures a low-angle daytime view of a bright blue sky, the sun blazing near the top-center and casting a persistent lens flare—a rainbow streak beneath it and a faint halo at the upper right. The camera appears steady, so the dark tree tops and the house roof with chimney and antenna remain along the bottom edge. Scattered white cumulus and wispy clouds fill the frame, drifting slowly across the sky. The cloud mass at the left edge creeps rightward, while the mid-right cluster also drifts rightward. A puffy cloud near the upper-right edge enters the view and enlarges. The horizontal wispy band in the lower-middle reshapes only modestly. Tiny dark specks appear at isolated spots, too sparse to follow. Throughout, the glare and foreground remain steady while the clouds keep passing.
